NOTICE

Source: NOTICE.md

cd’s climate data are derived from ERA5-Land, produced by ECMWF for the Copernicus Climate Change Service and distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0).

Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information.

ERA5-Land: Muñoz-Sabater, J., et al. (2021). ERA5-Land: a state-of-the-art global reanalysis dataset for land applications. Earth System Science Data, 13, 4349–4383. https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-13-4349-2021

cd reads ERA5-Land from the DestinE Earth Data Hub, aggregates and derives variables from it (seasonal and annual means and totals, vapour pressure deficit, relative humidity, soil moisture, snow metrics, and daily local-day air temperature), and publishes the results to s3://stac-era5-land.
